keywords: EIP-8250 验证前缀恢复不得回滚批准
summary: EIP-8250 合并一项安全修正：`POST_TX` 断言失败时会恢复验证前缀并丢弃交易主体，但交易仍有效并被打包，这种情况下付款范围的 `APPROVE` 效果也不得回滚，以保证 nonce 只花一次。L2BEAT 上线新功能，针对 5 种对手评估每个隐私协议“对谁私密”。Etheorem 的 Lean 4 共识规范已通过 Fulu、Gloas、Heze 三个分叉的 pyspec 测试向量。

items.title: EIP-8250：验证前缀恢复时不得回滚批准效果
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）合并。nonce 消耗一节列出了不得回滚付款范围 `APPROVE` 效果的情况：后续帧回滚、跳过后续帧、恢复原子批量快照，但没有提到 `POST_TX` 断言失败时的验证前缀恢复。这种恢复会丢弃交易主体，但交易仍有效并被打包。PR 把这一情况加入 MUST NOT 清单。
items.title_en: EIP-8250: forbid reverting approval effects on validation-prefix restore
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil) was merged. The nonce consumption section lists the rollbacks that must not revert a payment-scoped `APPROVE`'s effects: a later frame revert, skipping later frames and restoring an atomic-batch snapshot, but not the validation-prefix restore a `POST_TX` assertion failure performs, which discards the transaction body while keeping the transaction valid and included. The PR adds that case to the MUST NOT list.

keywords_en: EIP-8250 validation-prefix restore must not revert approval
summary_en: EIP-8250 merged a safety fix: when a `POST_TX` assertion fails, the validation prefix is restored and the transaction body discarded, but the transaction stays valid and included, and in that case the effects of a payment-scoped `APPROVE` must not be reverted either, so the nonce is spent only once. L2BEAT launched a feature assessing "private from whom" for each privacy protocol against 5 adversaries. Etheorem's Lean 4 consensus specs now pass the pyspec vectors on three forks, Fulu, Gloas and Heze.
